# Skill Instructions

## Purpose

Use this skill when you want to copy a codebase into an existing repository, update a library snapshot, or align a target repo with a source directory. It helps you commit and push changes safely while avoiding overwriting sensitive data or breaking the remote history.

The GitHub repository: https://github.com/bennyskov

- If the repository is not initialized, this skill will initialize it for you.
- If the repository does not exist on GitHub, it will create it.
- Do a commit and push to the repository, ensuring that the local changes are synchronized with the remote repository.
